page_title: LEC 0-0 BOL | Lecce v Bologna 09/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+5' Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball down to the middle of the goal. Wladimiro Falcone shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
90+3' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) has tested the patience of referee Francesco Fourneau and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+3' Balthazar Pierret (Lecce) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' Santiago Pierotti will be replaced by Konan Ndri (Lecce).
89' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Bologna due to an offside in the build-up play.
88' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Francesco Fourneau is going to take a look using VAR.
87' A goal, which was scored by Thijs Dallinga (Bologna), was disallowed due to offside.
86' Bologna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
86' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
85' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
85' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lecce.
84' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lecce comes to nothing. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lecce.
83' Substitution. Charalampos Lykogiannis will be replaced by Juan Miranda (Bologna).
83' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to make a change. Nikola Moro (Bologna) replaces Remo Freuler.
79' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) is substituted due to injury. Marco Giampaolo gives a chance to Medon Berisha.
77' Lecce failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
76' Today's match ends for Giovanni Fabbian who will be replaced by Thijs Dallinga (Bologna).
74' Jesper Karlsson (Lecce) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
72' Francesco Fourneau has a clear sight and sees a foul from Gaby Jean (Lecce). Bologna have a free kick.
70' It is time for a substitution. Jesper Karlsson (Lecce) is on for Tete Morente.
70' Marco Giampaolo has decided to substitute Ylber Ramadani and he is replaced by Balthazar Pierret (Lecce).
66' Emil Holm (Bologna) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.

63' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team. A free kick has been awarded to Bologna.
61' Francesco Fourneau shows a yellow card to Remo Freuler (Bologna) for his blatant foul.
58' Bologna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
58' Emil Holm (Bologna) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bologna.
57' Gaby Jean (Lecce) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Francesco Fourneau saw the whole situation. Bologna are awarded the free kick.
56' Vincenzo Italiano decides to make a substitution. Lorenzo De Silvestri will be replaced by Emil Holm (Bologna).
56' Here comes a substitution. Benjamin Dominguez is given a rest as he is replaced by Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna).
53' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) is able to continue to play.
52' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

48' Tete Morente (Lecce) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Francesco Fourneau no option but to blow his whistle. Bologna are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+4' Lecce can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
45+3' The resulting set piece from Lecce is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45+2' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Lecce earn a corner.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
43' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. That's a free kick to Lecce.
42' The free kick from long range, taken by Bologna, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

42' Remo Freuler (Bologna) was too forceful with his tackle and Francesco Fourneau interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Lecce win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
40' Neat passing move from Lecce in order to create new attacking opportunities.
38' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! There is a free kick near the sideline to Bologna.
34' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) commits a foul and Francesco Fourneau immediately signals a free kick. Bologna will take a free kick.
30' Handball by Nikola Krstovic (Lecce). Bologna are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
28' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Lecce.
28' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna).
21' Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
21' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

21' Remo Freuler (Bologna) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball goes out of play. Bologna are awarded a corner kick.

19' Federico Baschirotto (Lecce) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Francesco Fourneau with no other option than to blow for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Bologna.
18' The corner is swung in but Lecce can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

18' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) shoots the rebound towards the goal. His effort lacks pace and that allows the goalkeeper to pull off a stunning save. The ball is out of play and Lecce manage to earn a corner.
18' Lovely run from Santiago Pierotti (Lecce). He finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper, lines up a shot, but the keeper boldly launches himself to intercept the ball.
17' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna), but it's just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
17' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) prepares to take a corner kick.

12' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Francesco Fourneau stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. It's a free kick to Bologna in a dangerous position.
12' The Bologna players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
11' A cross from a corner kick by Bologna is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
9' The game gets underway again after that interruption.
7' The game is interrupted.

6' Santiago Castro (Bologna) latches on to a loose ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot on goal, but the effort lacks accuracy and flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
1' He should have scored! Tete Morente (Lecce) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Lecce will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Francesco Fourneau.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
